integrity: The proof normalizes support geometry, compactifies by allowing adjacent collisions, and uses Lagrange equations on every support-collision stratum. Any extremum with three or more distinct levels would force three roots of one quadratic, so global extrema reduce to two-level contiguous coarsenings. Exact-rational computation only replays finite cases.
scientific_limitations: The atom probabilities and their order are fixed; allowing probabilities to vary removes the finite skewness range.
The theorem treats one-dimensional skewness and does not classify higher standardized moments.
The sample-mean/sample-variance corollary classifies the normalized covariance and correlation sign, not the full correlation magnitude.
title: Endpoint masses determine the exact skewness range of a discrete law
